title: Filipino Tofu Bake
description: A nourishing and creamy Filipino-inspired tofu bake, perfect for a comforting meal. This recipe is a twist on traditional Filipino dishes, but with a healthier and more accessible twist.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine coconut milk, onion, garlic, and cayenne pepper (if using). Blend until smooth.
In a separate bowl, mix together tofu, salt, and black pepper.
In a baking dish, arrange a layer of cauliflower florets. Pour some of the coconut milk mixture over the cauliflower.
Add a layer of tofu on top of the cauliflower, followed by another layer of cauliflower. Repeat this process until all ingredients are used up, ending with a layer of coconut milk on top.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the top is lightly golden brown.
